questions.question: A study was made for the number of persons of different age group visited in a library in week which is shown in the histogram. Study the histogram and answer the question given below. ​ The ratio of the number of persons in the age groups 15 - 20 years and 20 - 25 years together, to the number of persons in the age groups 30 - 35 years and 35 - 40 year together, is:
questions.questionHtml:
A study was made for the number of persons of different age group visited in a library in week which is shown in the histogram. Study the histogram and answer the question given below.

​

The ratio of the number of persons in the age groups 15 - 20 years and 20 - 25 years together, to the number of persons in the age groups 30 - 35 years and 35 - 40 year together, is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Calculation:

No. of the person in the age group of 15 - 20 = 300

No. of the person in the age group of 20 - 25 = 400

Total no. of person in  the age groups 15 - 20 years and 20 - 25 years

⇒ 300 + 400

⇒ 700

No. of the person in the age group of 30 - 35 = 350

No. of the person in the age group of 35 - 40 = 100

Total no. of person in the age groups 30 - 35 years and 35 - 40 years  

⇒ 350 + 100

⇒ 450

The required ratio will be 700: 450

⇒ 14: 9

∴ The required ratio is 14 : 9

⇒ Total production of rice of state C in 2018 and 2019 = 60 + 45= 120

According to the formula,

⇒ Percentage=\(\frac{value\space of \space stateA}{value \space of \space stateC}\times 100=\frac{90}{120}\times100\)= 75%

Hence, The percentage of total rice production of state A in 2016 and 2017 from the total rice production of state C in 2018 and 2019 is 75%

The percentage decrease in the income of the company in 2002 as compared to that in 2001 is :
questions.solution:
Given:

Income in 2001, 2002 is 30, 25 lakhs respectively

Formula Used:

Percentage Difference = 100 × Difference/Initial amount

Calculation:

⇒ Decreased amount = 30 – 25 = 5 lakhs

∴ Percentage Difference = 100 × 5/30 = 16\(2\over3\)%
